node.title: Re: Use a perl script to empty a file and then replace it with data from a web form
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
In addition to what the others have said - [id://111088] and don't use that $FORM code - you are exposing yourself to a huge security hole by allowing people to entirely replace an HTML file (with [wp://Server Side Includes|SSIs] apparently). It's called a [wp://Cross-site scripting] (XSS) attack, here's a [https://excess-xss.com/|tutorial] (in fact, this is even worse, since you're allowing the page to be entirely replaced, not just portions of it).

Although I really think you should move away from [mod://CGI].pm ([id://1177808], [id://1182902], and [mod://CGI::Alternatives]), and you need to address the above security issue somehow (at the very least some password protection?), to answer your questions: Instead of your $FORM stuff, use the param function, and to overwrite a file, you just need to use a regular [doc://open] with a mode of ">" instead of ">>", this will clobber the file contents.
